orderedBlocks.text: Consider what you just learned from Deuteronomy and Mark regarding how to love the Lord with your heart, mind, soul, and strength. Each of us approaches these areas in a unique way. As we will learn later in the chapter on Story, our experiences have a great impact on our capacity and ability to love. Within the chapter on Expertise, we will explore how different talents and skills were developed. Some of them were shaped through the hard knocks of life, while others emerged from deep-seated passion.
Let’s take a few moments and consider the reflections lens as it relates to this greatest command, to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength.

As a lens, DesignID helps us understand our capacities and what fulfills us. This includes how we choose to spend our time, the efforts we make in different parts of our life, and how we mentally and emotionally approach situations and people. There is a strong correlation between the four reflections of DesignID and the way we live out the greatest commandment.
